name: Villardompardo (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, white at the hoist and the fly with blue quinas and red above and below with yellow castles.
history: Municipal flag of Villardompardo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: division per saltire, red above and below
groups of five escutcheons (quinas) in the white triangles
three castles in the upper triangle
three castles in the lower triangle
